entry.content:
Sep 18

2025

Fractals and the dynamics of Thurston maps
Abstract: A Thurston map is a branched covering map on a topological 2-sphere for which the forward orbit of each critical point under iteration is finite. Each such map gives rise to a fractal geometry on its underlying 2-sphere. The study of these maps and their associated fractal structures links diverse areas of mathematics such as dynamical systems, classical conformal analysis, hyperbo...
Speaker：Mario Bonk (University of California, Los Angeles)
